description: ITI Limited engages in the manufacture, sale, and servicing of telecommunication equipment and building communication network infrastructures in India. The company's electronic products includes digital mobile radio (DMR) system, smart energy meters, mini personal computers, smaash laptop, 3D Printing, bank automation products, GPON OLT and ONT, PCM multiplexers, ruggedized telephones for defence forces, smart cards and banking cards, hand held terminals for smart card authentication, set top boxes, Wi-Fi equipment, multiple types of encryptionevices for defence, solar power modules, switched mode power supply systems, IoT products, radio modems, and AN rack hardware. It also provides electronic and communication products, such as optical transport network product, managed leased line network products, signaling point network products, IP/MPLS routers and switches, network management system solution, microwave and satellite communication equipment, next generation network equipment, and IT products and solutions. In addition, the company offers services comprising data centre hosting, EMI/EMC and environmental testing of electronic products, 3D printing, mechanical fabrication, reliability engineering lab, installation, commissioning, peration and maintenance services for the supplied products, electronic contract manufacturing, printed circuit board (PCB) manufacturing, and component screening for mission critical components. ITI Limited was founded in 1948 and is based in Bengaluru, India.
